verses.pali: … Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye vavassaggārammaṇaṁ karitvā labhanti samādhiṁ labhanti cittassekaggataṁ;
verses.english: … so too the sentient beings who, relying on letting go, gain immersion, gain unification of mind are few,

verses.pali: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye vavassaggārammaṇaṁ karitvā na labhanti samādhiṁ na labhanti cittassekaggataṁ.
verses.english: while those who don’t gain immersion, don’t gain unification of mind relying on letting go are many.
